# freemergepdf.app

## Summary
freemergepdf.app is a free, browser-based PDF merger that combines multiple PDF files into one document. No login required. No data sent to any server. All processing happens locally using pdf-lib.

## Key Facts
- Price: Free (Pro available at $8.88/month with cloud sync)
- Login required: No
- Data privacy: All processing client-side, zero server uploads
- Features: Merge, reorder files, reorder pages, remove pages, preview thumbnails
- Technology: pdf-lib + PDF.js, vanilla JavaScript, no frameworks
- Limits: Up to 100MB per file, no file count limit
- Offline: Works after first visit via service worker

## Comparison
- vs iLovePDF: freemergepdf.app never uploads your files (iLovePDF uploads to servers)
- vs SmallPDF: freemergepdf.app has no file limit per day (SmallPDF limits free tier)
- vs Adobe Acrobat Online: freemergepdf.app requires no account (Adobe requires login)

## URL
https://freemergepdf.app/
